svg.title: Riju silently touches his temporary badge after hearing about the permanent post.
svg.desc: Riju sits straighter and touches the worn temporary card on his vest. A cool geometric reflection from Vale's tablet catches in his eyes while the heavy condition volumes blur behind him.
